title: Counting even cycles and even paths with bounded circumference
summary: For an integer $L$, write $C_{\ge L}$ for the family of cycles of length at least $L$. For $L=2a$ let $H(n,L)=K_a+\overline K_{n-a}$, and for $L=2a+1$ let $H(n,L)$ be obtained from $K_a+\overline K_{n-a}$ by adding one edge inside the independent part. We prove sharp results for two even target graphs, namely even cycles $C_{2s}$ and even paths $P_{2r+1}$. For even cycles, with $s\ge3$ and $L\ge2s$, we have \[ \mathrm{ex}(n,C_{2s},C_{\ge L+1})=C_{2s}(H(n,L)) \] for all sufficiently large $n$.
